heroSummary: PPS opened August 26, 2025, with later starts for comprehensive-school grades 7–8 and 10–11, kindergarten September 2, and Pre-K/Head Start September 4. A spring furlough agreement removed early release days and moved the final student day from June 9 to June 5, 2026.
calendarNotes: Most students began August 26, while grades 7–8 and 10–11 at comprehensive middle and high schools began August 27. Kindergarten used an August 27–29 Ramp Up before all kindergarten began September 2. Pre-K and Head Start began September 4, so their opening did not match the K–12 dates. Schools closed for day and evening conferences November 24–25 before the late-November break. The original calendar listed eight early release Wednesdays, but PPS's April 2026 revision removed early release and made April 22 and May 13 full instructional days. A furlough agreement closed schools May 1 and retained May 25 as an unpaid holiday for educators while moving the final student day to June 5. The supplied local PDF is for Portland, Maine, so none of its island-school, PATHS, February Break, or April Break dates are used here.

customSections.label: What the April 2026 PPS Revision Changed
customSections.content: PPS's furlough agreement designated May 1, May 25, June 9, and June 10 as educator furlough dates. For students, the practical calendar changes were no school May 1, a final student day of June 5 instead of June 9, a June 8 grading day, and full instructional days on April 22 and May 13 instead of early release. The district calendar page described the revised PDF as updated April 1, 2026, including furlough days and removing early release days.

customSections.label: Why the Supplied PDF Was Excluded
customSections.content: The supplied file uses a different Portland Public Schools logo, names Maine schools such as Peaks Island, Cliff Island, Ocean Avenue, and PATHS, lists a February Break and April Break, and directs readers to portlandschools.org. Those are Portland, Maine identifiers. This page covers Portland, Oregon at pps.net and therefore uses only Oregon PPS dates.

calendarFaqs.q: When did Portland Public Schools start in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Most students started Tuesday, August 26, 2025. Grades 7–8 and 10–11 at comprehensive middle and high schools started Wednesday, August 27.

calendarFaqs.q: When did PPS kindergarten start in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: The district scheduled Kindergarten Ramp Up August 27–29, then all kindergarten students began Tuesday, September 2, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: Did PPS keep early release days in spring 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: No. PPS said early release days were removed from the revised calendar. The furlough agreement specifically converted April 22 and May 13 into full instructional days.

calendarFaqs.q: Why was there no school on May 1, 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: May 1 was a district furlough day created through the 2025–26 cost-saving agreement. It was a no-school day for students and an unpaid non-work day for affected employees.

calendarFaqs.q: When was Portland Public Schools Spring Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break ran Monday, March 23, through Friday, March 27, 2026. Students returned Monday, March 30.

calendarFaqs.q: What was the final day of PPS in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The final student day was Friday, June 5, 2026. PPS moved it forward from the original June 9 date as part of the furlough calendar revision.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 8, 2026, using Oregon PPS calendar records and final furlough guidance; the supplied local PDF was identified as Portland, Maine and excluded from every date claim.
sourceReviewDetails: The supplied PDF was visually checked and identifies Maine schools, island campuses, PATHS, and portlandschools.org rather than Oregon PPS.
The official Oregon PPS base calendar supplies the staggered opening, Kindergarten Ramp Up, Pre-K/Head Start, quarter, conference, staff-day, and progress-report structure.
PPS's revised calendar notice says the April 1 version includes furlough days and removes early release days.
PPS furlough guidance confirms May 1, May 25, June 9, and June 10 and explains the move to a June 5 final student day and June 8 grading day.
School-level pages corroborate the November conferences, December 22–January 2 Winter Break, and March 23–27 Spring Break.
